Broadway Rave
events.info: Calling all Musical Theatre nerds, drama geeks, actors, actresses, theatre lovers, and more! Welcome to Broadway Rave: MasqueRave Edition, a Broadway Dance Party celebrating the best in show-tunes and musical theatre, with a spooky twist! Come sing along to all of your favorite Broadway hits while dressed up as your favorite character, Broadway star, or Halloween icon. Get ready for a night of theatrical tricks and treats. Live out your Broadway fantasies at Broadway Rave, now with a Halloween twist! Masks encouraged and drama required.
